title: AI Engineer
tagline: From Python and maths to machine learning, deep learning and LLMs
description: A rigorous path into modern AI. You build the Python and mathematics foundations, learn the data stack, then move through classical machine learning and deep learning to large language models and generative AI applications.
audience: Developers and graduates who want to build machine learning and LLM-powered systems

stages.title: Python
stages.description: The language of AI: syntax, data structures, functions, classes and environments.

stages.title: Mathematics fundamentals
stages.description: Linear algebra, probability, statistics and the calculus needed to understand training.
stages.topicNote: Mathematics is not a tutorial on this platform. The NumPy, Machine Learning and Deep Learning tutorials each start with the maths they need, and we link to free external courses for deeper study.

stages.title: Pandas
stages.description: Loading, cleaning and exploring tabular data.

stages.title: Machine learning
stages.description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, evaluation and feature engineering with scikit-learn.

stages.title: Deep learning
stages.description: Neural networks, CNNs, transformers and training with PyTorch or TensorFlow.

stages.title: Large language models
stages.description: How LLMs work, using APIs, prompting, fine-tuning and evaluation.

stages.title: Generative AI applications
stages.description: Build applications with LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation and responsible deployment.

seo.title: AI Engineer Learning Path
seo.description: Roadmap from Python and mathematics through NumPy, Pandas, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs and generative AI applications.
